source.source_text: Purpose: compute checksum for an allowed regular file without returning contents. Input: path:string, algorithm?:sha256|sha512. Output: algorithm, digest, size and normalized path. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.hash; target path; timeout 30000ms; cap 128KiB; network none; filesystem metadata/content-read only for hashing; secret bytes never returned; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
